rows.lexical_grammar_basis: The CNMI transitive na'annuk denotes bringing into view, not enlarging. Todu can stand for everything. Chung affirmative transitive imperatives omit agreement.
rows.caller_basis: All three text uses invoke PaintCanvas.fit(): zoom controls, zoom-tool options, and trim options. The click wrapper only gates busy/autosaving and catches errors. fit() adjusts viewport zoom/pan, resets polygon tap bookkeeping, invalidates, and invokes status/autosave callbacks. It does not resize the bitmap or apply trim.
semantic_limits: The short label obtains its object from the active drawing viewport. It is not a command to show all application controls or files.
A functional show-everything wording rather than a technical calque of Fit.
Bounds include the full bitmap, trim rectangle and any floating selection. On too-small views fit() returns without action.

rows.backtranslation: Bring the whole canvas into view.
rows.lexical_grammar_basis: CNMI na'annuk is visibility-oriented; todu i names the whole definite object. Brin is material canvas in the dictionary, extended here to the application drawing surface. Chung supports todu before i and an uninflected transitive imperative.
rows.caller_basis: The exact key supplies FIT icon content description, tooltip/help wording and fit control content description. The only FIT icon invocation and all related text buttons invoke the same view-fitting method.
semantic_limits: Digital canvas is an explicitly disclosed functional extension of material brin, not an attested software sense.
Whole canvas is guaranteed to be contained in computed fit bounds, which can additionally include trim handles or a floating selection; this is not a promise to remove those objects or resize them.
No source pixel resizing, crop application, or image-to-destination scaling is commanded.

rows.backtranslation: Size of the picture in the preview (%).
rows.lexical_grammar_basis: CNMI mineddung is size/dimensions; pinenta is pictured/drawn content; mostra is a sample or representative part. The noun phrase makes picture content the possessor of size, with gi mostra locating it within the sample/preview. Chung supports following possessors, zero linker after consonant-final mineddung, and fused local gi with definite common nouns. The dictionary map example independently attests mineddung i followed by a possessor.
rows.caller_basis: Both exact usages are NumericSlider controls for previewMagnification, in cursor options and showDrawingSettings(preview=true), beside the magnified drawing-preview toggle. Range 100–400 maps to factor 1–4. Drawing clips to the existing lens, scales its drawing transform by max(main zoom,1) times previewMagnification and draws the unchanged bitmap. magnifierBounds() computes frame size independently of previewMagnification.
semantic_limits: Mostra as digital preview is an authored functional extension, not a directly attested software term.
The label names size of pictured content within the preview, not size of the preview frame, source bitmap dimensions, or the main-canvas zoom slider.
The percentage is the relative lens multiplier. It is not an absolute one-source-pixel-to-screen-pixel ratio when main zoom exceeds one.

The phrase does not independently spell out the multiplier baseline; this limitation is compatible with the terse English label and both verified preview settings contexts. Do not reuse it for main-canvas zoom or bitmap resize without fresh review.
NumericSlider also uses the passed label in accessibility text and the numeric-entry dialog title. No runtime layout, glyph or accessibility behavior was exercised.

linguistic_findings.nch_load: NCH Romans3:11/13 supplies quitemohua and quitapohuaj; Matthew7:8 quitemohuaj; Matthew2:13 quitemos; 2Timothy4:11 Xijtemo; Revelation5:2–5 quitapos. The matching -ohua(j), -os and -o pattern supports analogical Xijtapo with own xij- transitive singular imperative morphology. It is not directly attested or inferred merely from a completed form. The functional extension from physical/text opening to this image-opening picker is reasonable.
linguistic_findings.nhw_load: NHW independently supplies the same seek paradigm in its own pages and quitlapohuaj/quitlapos for open. Analogical Xijtlapo preserves Western tl and own singular command morphology. No Central spelling or Classical grammar was substituted. The ellipsis correctly signals subsequent picker/format/resize choices.
linguistic_findings.share: NCH xijtitani and NHW xijtitlani are directly shown as commands. Each own corpus also sends an inanimate letter (quititanque/quititlanque). Each has quiajoctoc as kept/stored result and the respective cati/catli + named subject + quiajoctoc clause. Thus AN Paint is explicitly the storing agent and the image is the object of an invitation to send. This does not assert an already-completed or automatic transmission.
linguistic_findings.image_nouns: Retain accepted whole NCH ixkopinali from Hernández Beatriz printed64 and NHW tlaixkopintli from INALI Huasteca Potosina glossary PDF97/99. NCH includes picture/painting/copy senses rather than photography alone; NHW aligns with images as a visual-expression medium. No neighboring-variety noun substitution.
linguistic_findings.provenance_limits: NCH NT identifies Central Huasteca but not a village. NCH vocabulary identifies native Cruzhica/Xochiatipan authorship; retain the inherited Valiñas nch mapping and older indirect Glottolog2002 nhe bibliography conflict, without asserting uniform village orthography. NHW NT explicitly describes Tamazunchale Western speech and internal variation; INALI identifies regional Huasteca Potosina, not a contributor village.
linguistic_findings.confidence: Moderate, source-compositional. Whole UI phrases and digital senses are authored; Open imperatives are supported analogy, not exact published commands. No native-speaker, whole-phrase publication, layout or runtime certification is claimed or imposed as a gate.

caller_findings.load: Sole emitter at ClassicPaintActivity838 calls confirmReplacement then launchOpen(false). It requests OPEN_DOCUMENT (GET_CONTENT fallback), returns on cancellation, reads selected URI, may inspect format/resize and replaces the canvas only after decode. Open image is functionally appropriate and does not promise prior edits already saved, successful opening, original size, animation retention or pixel identity.
caller_findings.share: Sole emitter at1388 is Intent.createChooser title. writeImage1354–1372 encodes a temporary output, writes it to the chosen destination and only then calls shareSavedImage. shareSavedImage1380–1389 exposes that encoded file by ACTION_SEND/EXTRA_STREAM and launches Android’s chooser. Sending still requires the user’s choice; no automatic recipient or successful delivery is implied. This is stored output, not necessarily the saved editable document state.
